description: This file defines the Deviations class with statistical functions such as sumSquares, kurtosis, and skew, for calculations related to deviations in data sets within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Deviations
classes.description: Provides statistical deviation functions such as sumSquares, kurtosis, and skew for data analysis.

methods.name: sumSquares
methods.description: Calculates the sum of squared deviations of data points from their mean.

methods.name: kurtosis
methods.description: Calculates the kurtosis of a data set, indicating peakedness or flatness.

methods.name: skew
methods.description: Calculates the skewness of a distribution, indicating asymmetry.
